fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that an online contact allegedly demanded Rs. 25,000 from the complainant and threatened to share personal content. The matter was brought to Erode Central PS on 2025-05-31, while the incident was placed on 2025-05-28 at roughly 16:15. Harish Babu submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000422. Meena Sekar was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100051. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payment reportedly demanded under a threat of public exposure.
fields.Keywords: blackmail, online threat, college road, afternoon, witness, receiving account
